# Character sheets for AI video: passport, turnaround, expressions, voice

**Each character or hero prop gets a word-for-word passport, a turnaround sheet, six expressions and a voice line measured in wpm.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_fa6dbbcf6a07.webp" alt="A character passport for a woman in a long black coat: turnaround sheet, an expression grid, then film stills of her with a red umbrella at a rainy night bus stop." width="480"></p>

Cast an AI video before anything moves: for every character and hero prop, a passport (one paragraph, every visible detail, pasted word for word into every prompt), a turnaround sheet in the moodboard's look, six expressions written as cause + physical tells, a measured voice line (pace in words per minute, accent, one verbal habit), and for props the materials, wear and how they move and sound. Includes anti-slop design rules, a prompt builder that refuses paraphrased passports, code routes (three.js, VRM, SVG face rig) and tested reference sites. Use for "make a character", "consistent character", "character sheet", "turnaround", "character bible", "expression sheet", "voice for my character", "prop sheet", "same person in every shot", or characters that look generic, plastic or different from shot to shot. Not for category looks (varg-character-design), real actor photos in multi-scene ads (varg-consistent-characters) or the film's look (video-moodboard).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill character-passport                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills character-passport --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```
